quality_limit: Three synthetic structured-output cases, not proof of coding or security-review ability.
review_first_attempt: truncated_output; no completed review, output not applied

review_assessments.claim: Frame rejects bodies, so the owner's POST RPC makes all API requests fail.
review_assessments.reason: Different JavaScript realms: frame fetch sends a GET intent via postMessage; parent performs the authenticated POST. Real browser test reached /api/total and displayed 2576.

review_assessments.claim: targetOrigin '*' exposes init data to any window.
review_assessments.reason: Message is addressed to the exact frame.contentWindow, not broadcast. Opaque origin requires wildcard targeting. Parent verifies source and null origin before handling requests. No credentials enter frame.

review_assessments.claim: Stripping a leading slash resolves assets against sandbox origin and bypasses paths.
review_assessments.reason: Resolver only looks up an own string property in public assets; it makes no fetch. Unsafe schemes, dot segments, doubled slashes and nonmatching paths return no source.

review_assessments.claim: Parent fails to validate application-reply id and permits state injection.
review_assessments.reason: Parent sends replies, not receives them. It accepts application-request only with a safe integer id; frame accepts replies only from parent for existing pending IDs.
